_docs.hideCategory: Set "hidden": true on a filter option to remove it from the shop UI (Bags is hidden for now). Set "hidden": false or delete the field to show it again.
_docs.addCategory: Add { "label", "value" } under filters.options. Use the same value as product.category in product-catalog.json. For headcover types, add under the Headcovers option's children and set product.subcategory.
_docs.addProduct: Add a product in product-catalog.json with category (headcovers | towels | bags) and optional subcategory (center-shafted | mallet | oz-mezz).
